The CMAT result 2026 is released by the National Testing Agency on 17 February on NTA official website cmat.nta.nic.in. The Common Management Entrance Test is the entrance exam conducted by NTA for the candidates seeking admission in MBA, PGDM and other management programs for the 2026-28 academic session. Candidates can download their scorecards after logging into the NTA website using their credentials. The scorecard reflect the candidate’s overall score, percentile, and ranking in the CMAT exam. On the basis of these scores, the cut offs of various management colleges will be released.

CMAT Result 2026 Out

The CMAT exam result is released by NTA on its official website, announcing the scores, percentiles and ranks of the candidates who appeared for the entrance exam. On the basis of these percentiles and scores various business and management schools releases their cutoffs, accepting admissions in MBA or PGDM courses. Candidates are advised to download their CMAT result using their login details and start applying in various colleges on the basis of their previous year’s cutoff.

CMAT Result 2026 Notice PDF

CMAT 2026 Result Date

CMAT exam result is released by NTA on 17th February 2026 along with the final answer key. CMAT exam was conducted on 25th January and the provisional answer key was released on 31st January 2026. Candidates who found any mistake in the provisional answer key were allowed to raise objections against it within a stipulated period till 2nd February. Let’s take a brief view of important dates in CMAT exam cycle:

Event Date
CMAT 2026 Exam Date 25 January 2026
Provisional Answer Key Release 31 January 2026
Objection Window for Answer Key Till 2 February 2026
CMAT 2026 Result Announcement 17 February 2026
Final Answer Key Release 17 February 2026

CMAT 2026 Result Link

Candidates can download their CMAT result after logging in to the official website of the NTA at cmat.nta.nic.in or they can also directly download the result from the direct link provided below. CMAT scorecard are available online. Candidates are advised to download and save their CMAT result 2026 pdf properly for future use in their admission process.

Direct CMAT Result 2026 Link

CMAT Result 2026 Live Updates

CMAT 2026 Result: What are the CMAT colleges fees?

MBA course fees in CMAT colleges usually range from ₹4 lakh to ₹22 lakh for the full program. Government institutes are comparatively affordable, while private B-schools have higher fee structures.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:45:39 AM IST

CMAT Result 2026: What is the average package offered by CMAT colleges?

The average MBA placement package in CMAT-accepting colleges generally ranges between ₹6 LPA to ₹14 LPA, depending on the institute, specialization, and candidate profile.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:40:51 AM IST

CMAT Exam Result: Which colleges have the highest CMAT cut off?

Colleges like JBIMS Mumbai and SIMSREE Mumbai usually have 99+ percentile cut-offs, while institutes such as Great Lakes Chennai and Goa Institute of Management generally require 95–99 percentile scores.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:35:06 AM IST

CMAT Result 2026: What are the best CMAT colleges for MBA?

Top MBA colleges through CMAT include JBIMS Mumbai, SIMSREE Mumbai, Welingkar Institute of Management Development and Research, BIMTECH, Greater Noida, and Jaipuria Institute of Management, Noida.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:30:43 AM IST

CMAT Result Live: Which are the best colleges under the CMAT exam?

Some of the top colleges accepting CMAT scores include Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies, SIMSREE, K J Somaiya Institute of Management, Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai, and Goa Institute of Management.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:25:44 AM IST

How many colleges are participating in the CMAT exam?

More than 1,300 AICTE-approved management institutes across India accept CMAT scores for MBA/PGDM admission every year. The exam is conducted by the National Testing Agency.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:20:36 AM IST

What are CMAT 2026 final answer key dates?

If any of the objections against the provisional answer key is accepted then the CMAT 2026 final answer key was released by the NTA along with the exam result.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:15:13 AM IST

What is CMAT 2026 result website?

CMAT result 2026 download link is updated at this website cmat.nta.nic.in on 17th February. Candidates can download the scorecard from there.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:05:29 AM IST

What is the validity of CMAT scores?

CMAT scores are valid for a single academic year only. Hence, the candidates who want to take a drop this year, will have to appear for the CMAT exam again next year.

Updated on: 18 Feb 2026 | 12:01:06 AM IST

Can students apply for CMAT 2026 result revaluation?

Candidates can not apply for revaluation or recalculation of the scores obtained in CMAT 2026 exam. Scores mentioned in the scorecard released by NTA are final.

Updated on: 17 Feb 2026 | 11:55:51 PM IST

Is there Normalisation in CMAT exam 2026?

CMAT exam was conducted in a single shift this year, therefore, there will be no score normalisation this year.

Updated on: 17 Feb 2026 | 11:50:48 PM IST

How to Download CMAT result 2026?

CMAT 2026 result can be downloaded from the official website of cmat.nta.nic.in. Candidates will have to login with application ID and password to download the scorecard.

Updated on: 17 Feb 2026 | 11:47:48 PM IST

How many candidates apply for CMAT exam 2026?

The total number of candidates who sat for the CMAT 2026 exam is 53,543. This number is around 15% less than the previous year.

What is CMAT Final answer key date 2026?

If the objections raised by the candidates against the provisional answer key are accepted by NTA then the CMAT 2026 final answer key are released along with the exam result.

Updated on: 17 Feb 2026 | 11:40:32 PM IST

Information mentioned on CMAT Scorecard.

CMAT scorecard has the personal details of the candidate, their signature, sectional score, overall score and percentile obtained in the exam. Candidates should save the MBS CMAT result 2026 pdf for future reference.

Updated on: 17 Feb 2026 | 11:37:37 PM IST

What is the CMAT cutoff 2026?

CMAT admission is not centralized by the National Testing Agency. Candidates have to apply separately to each college according to their individual cutoffs.

Updated on: 17 Feb 2026 | 11:33:12 PM IST

Credentials required for viewing CMAT result 2026?

CMAT result 2026 MBS can be viewed after entering the following credentials at cmat.nta.nic.in: CMAT application ID and password.

When will the CMAT result 2026 release?

MPA CMAT result 2026 was released by NTA on its official website on 17th February 2026, i.e., today. Students need to login using their credentials to view their scorecards.

How to Download CMAT Result 2026 Scorecard?

Candidates who appeared for the CMAT 2026 exam can check their result online by following simple steps. Make sure you keep your registration details ready before you begin.

Step 1: Visit the official website of the National Testing Agency at cmat.nta.nic.in.

Step 2: Once on the homepage, find and click on the “CMAT 2026 result” notification.

Step 3: After opening the result page, Enter your registration number and date of birth or password, along with the captcha code shown on the screen. Make sure you fill in the details correctly.

Step 4: After entering the required information, click on the “View Result” button. Your result displayed on the screen. Carefully check all the details mentioned in your result.

What Details are Required for CMAT Scorecard 2026?

CMAT scorecard pdf can be downloaded only after entering correct login details on the website. Candidates should keep all the details ready before logging in the page to avoid last minute problems. Following Credentials are required for downloading CMAT Scorecard 2026:

  • CMAT Application ID
  • Password

Details Mentioned on CMAT 2026 Scorecard?

Since the CMAT 2026 scorecard is available with the result, candidates can download and view their scorecards and determine their qualifying status. The CMAT exam result cum scorecard contains the following details:

  • Name of the candidate
  • Roll number
  • Candidate’s signature
  • Sectional score
  • Sectional percentile
  • Overall score
  • Overall percentile

Check your rank with CMAT 2026 Rank Predictor.

CMAT 2026 Final Answer Key

CMAT exam was conducted on 25th January and the provisional answer key for the same was released on 31st January. Candidates were allowed to raise objections against the answer key till 2nd February. CMAT final answer key pdf released alongside the result resolving the objections raised against the provisional answer key by the candidates.

Download CMAT Final Answer Key 2026

Number of Candidates Appeared in CMAT 2026

The National Testing Agency (NTA) released the public notice on 31st January announcing that the total number of candidates who appeared for CMAT 2026 examination are 53,453. If we do the comparison analysis, we can see around 15% drop compared to the previous year. A total of 63,145 students took the CMAT 2025. In numbers this drop is about 10,000 students.

How to Rectify Errors on CMAT 2026 Scorecard?

NTA does not allow the students to apply for rechecking or revaluation of the scores they have obtained. Only the errors related to the personal information can be rectified by raising a query with the NTA helpdesk. This is also allowed only when the candidate has not made that error while in the registration process. Errors made in the application process can be rectified when the correction window is open.

Top MBA Colleges Accepting CMAT 2026 Score

Admissions through CMAT scores is not yet centralized by NTA, candidates are required to apply separately to each college that accepts CMAT score for MBA admissions. Therefore, it is important for the candidates to get a list of all the colleges accepting CMAT scores for further admission process. CMAT Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When will the CMAT 2026 Result be announced?
 Ans. The CMAT 2026 result was announced by the National Testing Agency on 17th February 2026 at its official website cmat.nta.nic.in. Candidates who appeared for the exam can check their qualifying status by viewing their result online.

Q2. Where can I check my CMAT 2026 Result?
 Ans. You can check your result by visiting the official website of the National Testing Agency (NTA) at cmat.nta.nic.in.

Q3. What details do I need to check the result?
 Ans. To view the result, you need CMAT Application ID and Password. Keep these details ready before downloading the scorecard.

Q4. How the result be released?
 Ans. The result is released online on the official website. Candidates need to log in to download their scorecard.

Q5. What information are be mentioned in the result?
 Ans. The CMAT result PDF have your name, roll number, marks obtained, percentile score, All India Rank (AIR), and qualification status.
